title: Continuing Recovery of Overpayments from DHMO Capitation Payments (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
This rule covers one recovery action under the **Network Participation Agreements**. It is the withholding Cascade books against a capitation payment of a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement to continue the recovery of an overpayment already under recovery on that agreement, and it covers only such a continuing capitation withholding. How a first withholding from a capitation payment and every withholding from a claim payment run are measured is stated in the sentence on the order and limits of offsets below.

## Scope among the practice's agreements

Overpayments are recovered at the level of the practice: an open overpayment under one agreement may be offset against remittances under any active or termination pending agreement of the same practice, except that a continuing capitation withholding, a continuing run withholding, a post-decision withholding and a plan installment each select only among the overpayments of the agreement whose payment they are withheld from, and only those four do.

## Order and limits of offsets

Open overpayments of the practice are offset oldest notice first, except that a continuing capitation withholding and a continuing run withholding go to the overpayment the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to, a post-decision withholding goes to the overpayment of the agreement's most recent dispute decision and a plan installment goes to the overpayment the plan down payment was recorded against, and only those four withholdings follow these selections instead of notice order; the total withheld from a claim payment run may not exceed the agreement type's recoupment percentage of that run's claim payments, while a withholding from a capitation payment is measured against the capitation amount itself, at the agreement type's recoupment percentage of it for the first withholding of an overpayment and at the continuing capitation withholding share for a continuing capitation withholding.

## Effect

The continuing capitation withholding is due once its conditions hold, and Cascade books it. The booking reduces the open amount of the overpayment under recovery by the amount withheld. It appears on the practice's capitation remittance advice as an amount withheld.

## Invocation: `book_capitation_withholding_57430a7a`

**Capability.** The tool books a continuing withholding against a capitation payment of a DHMO primary care dentist agreement. One call adds one withholding entry to the agreement's overpayment ledger, which lowers the open amount of that overpayment by the amount withheld.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `provider_agreement_id` | Reference number of the network participation agreement whose capitation payment is withheld from, as returned by the agreement lookup for the practice | Id |
| `original_payment_event_id` | Reference number of the overpayment notice entry being recovered, as returned by the provider payment and overpayment lookup for that agreement | Id |
| `remittance_number` | Remittance advice number of the capitation payment withheld from, copied character for character from the remittance entry, preserving every letter, digit and hyphen with no normalisation | Verbatim text |
| `withheld_amount` | Amount kept from the capitation payment | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent by the caller |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the booking:

- `status`: the text "booked" when the withholding entry was added;
- `entry_id`: reference number of the new withholding entry;
- `provider_agreement_id`: echoed;
- `overpayment_case_number`: case number printed on the overpayment notice recovered;
- `remittance_number`: echoed;
- `amount`: USD with 2 decimal places, the amount withheld;
- `event_date`: date YYYY-MM-DD on which the withholding was booked.
